task_completion.description: The agent successfully launches CoppeliaSim and opens the simulation environment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim application window is visible, showing a 3D scene with a robot arm.

task_completion.description: The agent starts the simulation to allow the robot arm to move and collect data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Play' button in the CoppeliaSim toolbar is toggled, and the simulation timer is incrementing.

task_completion.description: The agent systematically moves the robot arm through various joint configurations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the robot arm in different physical poses/orientations within the 3D view.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the per-configuration records to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal command shows the creation of '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/workspace_samples.csv' with at least 50 rows of data.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the aggregate workspace statistics to the specified JSON path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or text editor shows '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/workspace_report.json' containing a 'total_samples' value of 50 or greater.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim GUI or API rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the robot arm actually moving in the simulator, not just a static image while files are written.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type out 50 rows of coordinates into a text editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent uses a script or the Remote API to automate the data collection process.

integrity.description: The agent used the exact file paths specified in the requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the terminal or file manager match '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/' exactly.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must collect at least 50 distinct samples. The output files must be exactly '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/workspace_samples.csv' (containing >= 50 rows) and '/home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/workspace_report.json' (containing a 'total_samples' key with a value >= 50). The simulation environment used is 'movementViaRemoteApi.ttt'.
